{{Quote|What is this, a staring contest? Why don't they just send us in?''"<br />"''We go when we go. Quit complaining.|The soldier and a dutiful comrade|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|human]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="GenderCite" /> served as a '''soldier''' in the [[Mantellian Army]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] and the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] can be heard in the Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> the [[Mantellian Trooper]] participated in the Republic's [[Blockade of Talloran village|blockade]] of [[Talloran village]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> which was intended to contain the Separatist forces that had [[Takeover of Talloran village|seized control]] of the settlement.<ref name="Desperate Times">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Desperate Times|Ord Mantell}}</ref> While waiting, they complained about the lack of action before being lectured by a [[Unidentified Mantellian soldier 2 (blockade of Talloran)|dutiful comrade]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] had a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|beard]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. They found the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces']] lack of action during the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] irritating, and complained about it. During the blockade, They wore the blue [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] of Mantellian [[Army/Legends|Army]] personnel, and had a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] strapped to their back.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The soldier appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The soldier is identified as "Impatient Soldier" in the game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
